image_prompt.text: A small wooden dock running out from the beach over the water — the spot the fishing is actually done from
A slightly elevated island interior rising gently from the shoreline to a low grassy crown, no cliffs or steep ground
Open tropical sea ringing the island, shallow and clear over the sand and deepening past the end of the dock — the water fished from
A sandy beach shoreline wrapping the whole edge of the island
Lush green grass covering the raised top of the island
A few palm trees scattered across the grassy interior
Rocks dotted along the shore where the sand meets the water

layout_placement.text: Fishing station at the end of the wooden dock, driving the repeatable cast-and-catch loop

notes: Classified Simulation from the stated "fishing world game": a repeatable catch-and-sell job loop. The rest of the prompt is a pure place description, so no-genre was considered and rejected because the game type is named.

Preset Role Sim taken on its own shape world-shared — the island is one common world with no per-player plot. path-road-vehicle dropped as contradicted by a small cozy island with no vehicles or roads; path-circulation dropped as unasked, with no hub or production zone to chain.
water-body carries CHECK: the sea is a flat surround with no layered or self-occluding volume, so the play envelope should clear it trivially.
terrain-relief is P0 + tiered — "slightly elevated" is a gentle rise with no overhangs, caves, or tunnels, so it stays off P2.
No counts emitted: "a few palm trees" and "a small wooden dock" state no number, so the wording is carried in text instead.

Request no option covers: configurable attributes for island size, sand colour, grass colour, number of palm trees, and dock length. That is parameterisation of the build rather than geometry or a placed marker, so it is in neither list.

would have asked: Sounds like a shared fishing world with the island as one common space — a sandy beach ring, a gently raised grassy interior with a few palms, rocks along the shore, and a small wooden dock out over the water as the spot you actually fish from. Want that, or would you rather build it up yourself?

would have asked: nothing in the prompt names shops, upgrade gates, or vehicles, so I left the walkways and hauling roads off rather than paving a small cozy island — say if you did want a path from the beach up to the dock.
would have asked: Anything else you want in the space?
